pr.title: Fix search saying No items yet. when nothing matches

lenses.note: The change does what the title says. It is a small bug fix with one obvious design, so it needed no spec.
There is no spec file in this change.

Three new tests cover no matches, an escaped query and an empty table. The first two would fail on the old code. The empty-table test is a regression guard. The DELETE pattern matches test/index.test.js. I did not run the tests; CI covers them.
README.md only describes the `?q=` search at a general level. No doc mentions the empty-state message.
The message is escaped, and the extra COUNT query only runs when a search finds nothing. The message falls back to 'No items yet.' when the table is empty.
The query is escaped through escapeHtml in both the message and the input value. The SQL uses bound parameters. The `empty` value is built only from the escaped query or a constant.
The only template change is the text of one empty-state message. No styles or components are touched.
The diff changes no UI structure or flow, only the wording of one message.
The title is under 72 characters. The body's claims match the diff: the new message is escaped, the empty table keeps its old text, and no tests were deleted.
